name: installed-app-not-source
description: Rajat tests Natively via the installed /Applications/Natively.app, so source edits do nothing until rebuilt
metadata:
  type: project
---

Rajat runs the installed /Applications/Natively.app (bundle built 2026-05-10), not a build of this repo. As of 2026-11-12 the repo had no node_modules or dist-electron. The sandbox blocks registry.npmjs.org, so npm install has to be run by him.

**Why:** Twice on 2026-11-12 he said a fix was "still not working". The cause was that the installed app had none of the edits; grepping app.asar for the new prompt text found nothing.

**How to apply:** Before blaming the code, check whether the running build contains the change (grep Contents/Resources/app.asar for a new string). After any fix, tell him to run `npm install && npm start` to test, or `npm run dist` to rebuild the app.

I can't build it from here because the sandbox blocks the npm package registry. In this folder, run:

```
npm install
npm start
```
